_comment: ALEX Suite titration step: a concentration/file table, three settings, one Fit button, the stack plot, the binding isotherm and the numbers. Everything the old TitrationViewController showed, without the panel-per-option layout.

sections.text: One burst file per ligand concentration. All of them are histogrammed and fitted **together**, with the populations held at one shared position and width — only their amounts are free. That is what makes the amounts comparable between concentrations.

columns.label: Concentration
columns.description: Ligand concentration of this measurement. Any unit — the fitted K_d comes back in the same one.

columns.label: Burst file
columns.description: The .bur/.pto burst table this concentration was measured in.

buttons.label: ➕ Add burst files…
buttons.description: Add one row per burst file; then type each concentration.

sections.label: Populations
sections.description: How many FRET populations the whole series is described with. Two is the usual case: free and bound.

sections.label: Isotherm
sections.description: hill fits the cooperativity too; one_site holds the Hill coefficient at 1.

sections.label: Unit
sections.description: Only a label — the fit never converts. The K_d is reported in this unit.

sections.label: Fix peak positions
sections.description: Hold the shared centres and widths at their starting values instead of fitting them. Use it when a control measurement has already established where the populations are.

sections.label: Min. photons
sections.description: Bursts with fewer photons than this are dropped, in every condition alike.

sections.label: S gate from
sections.description: Only bursts inside this stoichiometry band enter the E histogram — the gate that removes donor-only and acceptor-only species.

sections.label: S gate to
sections.description: Upper edge of the stoichiometry gate.

sections.label: γ
sections.description: Detection/quantum-yield ratio. Take it from the Accurate FRET step.

sections.label: β
sections.description: Excitation-flux ratio, which enters the stoichiometry only.

sections.title: Stack plot
sections.description: One efficiency histogram per concentration, offset upwards; the dashed curve on each is the shared-shape fit.

sections.title: Binding isotherm
sections.description: The fraction of the reporting population against ligand concentration, with the fitted isotherm.
